summary.headline: Moon and Void-of-Course Planets
summary.text: Horary instructions for judging an inquiry through the Moon, the lord of the ascendant, and planets returning light to the ascendant. It explains void-of-course planets, changing the Moon to the next sign, planetary speed, and Saturn’s particular malignity and slowness.
